content: Provide continuous support to address the emotional well-being of the patient and to facilitate necessary lifestyle adjustments. Utilize monitoring tools, such as continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) or blood glucose monitoring (BGM), to track key biomarkers, including blood glucose levels, body weight, blood pressure, and lipid profiles. Adjust medications as needed to optimize both their tolerability and therapeutic effectiveness, ensuring that any side effects or challenges encountered during treatment are promptly identified and managed.
